candidates.change_summary: Change the returned selector to a wrong constant so onERC721Received returns a different bytes4 value.
Return zero (0x00000000) instead of the expected selector, producing a different return value while not reverting.
Return the bitwise-inverted selector of onERC721Received so the returned bytes4 differs.
Initialize sets baseToken to address(0) unconditionally instead of using the provided _baseToken argument.
Initialize sets baseToken to the factory address instead of the provided _baseToken argument.
Initialize assigns baseToken from nft parameter (swapped), so baseToken becomes _nft instead of _baseToken.
Replace assignment to nft with a no-op (commented out) so nft remains previous value instead of being set to _nft.
Assign nft to address(0) unconditionally instead of setting it to the provided _nft parameter.
Swap assignments: set baseToken to _nft and nft to _baseToken, so nft differs after initialization.
Replace the assignment to changeFee so the stored value is reduced by 1 (underflow-safe in Solidity 0.8 via revert if invalid) — changes changeFee observed after initialize.
Replace the assignment feeRate = _feeRate; with feeRate = _feeRate + 1; so initialize sets feeRate to a different value.
Replace the assignment feeRate = _feeRate; with feeRate = 0; forcing initialize to always set feeRate to zero.
Insert an extra validation that reverts when _feeRate is zero, preventing feeRate being set to 0 and thus changing observable feeRate when callers pass 0.
Remove the line that sets initialized = true so initialize() no longer marks the contract as initialized.
Set initialized = false at end of initialize(), forcing initialized to remain false after initialization completes.
Move the initialized = true assignment to the start of initialize() so it becomes true before the AlreadyInitialized check (allowing reverts to still see initialized true in some cases).
Replace the assignment of payRoyalties to flip the provided parameter (store ! _payRoyalties instead of _payRoyalties).
